_about: Cases every Sony implementation must reproduce. acks: the two acknowledgement frames Sony's app (com.sony.songpal.mdr 13.3.0) holds as constants, by the sequence number of the message they answer. first_replies: the reply to CONNECT_GET_PROTOCOL_INFO (00 00) as Gadgetbridge's notes give it for real earbuds and headphones, with the table set its length means.
